name: archive.is
summary: On-demand page archiver — saves a permanent screenshot and HTML copy.
detail: Archives a URL on demand and gives you a permanent link to the frozen copy. Unlike Wayback Machine it renders JavaScript, so it captures dynamic content. Critical for evidence preservation.
howTo: Paste the target URL into the input field
Click Save to create a new archive
proTip: Use archive.ph (same service) if archive.is is blocked in your region.

name: Unfurl
summary: Decodes URLs, timestamps, and tokens embedded in links.
detail: Paste any URL and Unfurl visually breaks it apart — decoding Base64, timestamps (Unix, Windows FILETIME), UUIDs, and platform-specific parameters. Invaluable for decoding tracking pixels, redirect cha…
howTo: Paste the full URL (including query string) into the input
proTip: Particularly powerful for decoding Google, Facebook, and advertising redirect URLs that contain encoded timestamps.

name: DeepL Translator
summary: Highest-quality machine translation — better than Google for most languages.
detail: Neural machine translation with best-in-class quality for European languages and Japanese. Preserves formatting and nuance better than alternatives. Essential for translating foreign-language OSINT.
howTo: Paste text or upload a document (PDF, DOCX, PPTX)
Select source language (or leave on Auto-detect)

name: Cryptpad
summary: End-to-end encrypted collaborative documents and spreadsheets.
detail: Zero-knowledge encrypted office suite. Documents are encrypted in the browser before upload — the server can never read your content. Good for collaborative OSINT case files.
howTo: Create a document (no account needed for temporary)
proTip: The encryption key is in the URL after the # — never share that URL over an insecure channel.

name: Recon Tool
summary: Browser-based OSINT workflow builder and note-taking tool.
detail: A structured workspace for organizing OSINT investigations. Create entities (person, domain, IP), link them, and attach evidence. Runs in-browser with local storage.

name: Sci-Hub
summary: Free access to academic papers behind paywalls.
detail: Provides free access to millions of research papers. Paste a DOI, PMID, or paper URL to retrieve the full PDF. Essential for accessing academic OSINT research.
howTo: Copy the DOI or URL of the paper you need
Paste into the Sci-Hub search box

name: OCR Text Extractor (OSINT.SH)
summary: Extract text from images using OCR — browser-based.
detail: Upload an image and extract all text via optical character recognition. Useful for pulling text from screenshots, photos of documents, and image-based data.

name: CyberChef
summary: GCHQ's cyber Swiss Army knife — encode, decode, analyze in-browser.
detail: A web app for data transformation and analysis. Chain 300+ operations: decode Base64, extract URLs from text, compute hashes, parse dates, decompress archives, and much more. Runs entirely in your bro…
howTo: Drag operations from the left panel into the Recipe area
Paste your input data into the Input pane
proTip: Use 'Magic' operation to auto-detect encoding and suggest the right decode chain for unknown data.

name: theHarvester
summary: Gathers emails, subdomains, IPs, and URLs from public sources.
detail: CLI tool that queries search engines, Shodan, LinkedIn, and other sources to harvest emails, names, subdomains, and IP addresses associated with a target domain. One of the most widely used recon tool…

name: SpiderFoot
summary: Automated OSINT platform aggregating 200+ data sources.
detail: Comprehensive OSINT automation tool with a web UI and CLI. Point it at a target (domain, IP, email, name) and it automatically queries 200+ sources, correlates the data, and builds a relationship grap…
proTip: Use the 'All' module set for comprehensive coverage but expect 30-60 minutes on a domain scan. Footprint scan is faster …

name: Maltego
summary: Visual link-analysis platform — maps entity relationships graphically.
detail: The industry standard for visual intelligence analysis. Drag-and-drop entities (Person, Domain, IP, Organization) onto a graph, run Transforms to auto-populate connected data, and build a visual relat…
howTo: Download and install Maltego CE (Community Edition — free)
proTip: Install community transforms from the Transform Hub — many are free and add significant data coverage.

name: Recon-ng
summary: Modular web reconnaissance framework — batteries-included OSINT CLI.
detail: A full-featured reconnaissance framework with a console interface similar to Metasploit. Install modules from the marketplace, create workspaces per investigation, and run automated queries against do…
proTip: Add API keys to the keys store (keys add shodan_api YOURKEY) to unlock modules that require authentication.

name: Photon
summary: Fast web crawler for OSINT — extracts URLs, emails, files, and keys.
detail: Crawls a target website and extracts all URLs, email addresses, file links, JavaScript endpoints, and potential API keys. Much faster than manual browsing. Good for mapping a target's web presence.

name: Metagoofil
summary: Extracts metadata from publicly available documents (PDF, DOC, XLS, PPT).
detail: Searches Google for documents published by a target domain, downloads them, and extracts all embedded metadata. Metadata frequently contains employee names, software versions, internal file paths, and…
proTip: PDF metadata often contains the author's full name, the software used, and sometimes the printer name revealing the offi…
installCommand: git clone https://github.com/opsdisk/metagoofil && pip install -r metagoofil/requirements.txt

name: Canary Tokens
summary: Plant a tracking beacon — get alerted when someone opens it.
detail: Generate a URL, Word doc, PDF, or image that phones home when opened. You get an email alert with the opener's IP, user agent, and timestamp. Use for detecting if subjects are clicking your links or o…
howTo: Select the token type (URL, Word, PDF, Image, etc.)
Enter your email for alert notifications
proTip: Use a Word doc token in a document left on a file share to detect unauthorized access. Email tokens reveal who's forward…

name: CrackStation
summary: Free hash lookup against a 15 billion entry rainbow table.
detail: Lookup MD5, SHA1, SHA256, and other common hashes against a massive precomputed table. Fast and free. No cracking required — if the hash is in the table, you get the plaintext instantly.
howTo: Paste one or more hashes into the text box (one per line)
proTip: Bulk lookup: paste up to 20 hashes at once separated by newlines.

name: Hashes.com
summary: Community-powered hash database with 22 billion+ cracked hashes.
detail: Combines a massive community-submitted rainbow table with an online cracking service. Supports MD5, SHA1, SHA256, SHA512, NTLM, bcrypt, and more. Active community submits new cracks constantly.
howTo: Paste the hash into the input field
Select the hash type if known (or leave on Auto)

name: Hashmob Community
summary: OSINT-focused hash cracking community with active submissions.
detail: A community platform for hash cracking. Search the shared database, submit hashes for community cracking, and contribute recovered hashes to help others. Focus on OSINT and security research use cases…
howTo: Search the database with your hash
If not found, create a free account and submit for cracking

name: yt-dlp
summary: Download video/audio from 1000+ sites including YouTube, Twitter, TikTok.
detail: The most actively maintained video downloader. Supports 1000+ sites. Downloads video, audio, subtitles, thumbnails, and metadata. Essential for preserving social media video evidence.
proTip: Use --write-info-json to save all metadata (upload date, description, comments, view count) alongside the video. Critica…

name: Export Comments
summary: Export all comments from YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok.
detail: Web tool that scrapes and exports all comments from a social media post or video. Exports to Excel/CSV. Useful for analyzing sentiment, finding usernames, and archiving comment evidence.
howTo: Paste the URL of the post or video
